title: forge.rate.limited payload v1
description: GATE-ON-PUSH R4: the forge refused a call of the one REST client on its primary or secondary rate limit, and every process of the session waited for the block (forge_rate). Recorded at the refusal and published after the block ends, best effort.

kind.description: Which forge limit refused the call (forge_rate.limited).

endpoint.description: The request path's shape: query dropped, ids as :id.

at.description: When the forge refused the call (RFC 3339, UTC).

blocked_s.description: The block every process of the session waited for, jitter included.
